notes: Original SUT outcomes, IPC/focus/method errors and strict eligibility are preserved. The selected impaired seed47 status-ack INCOMPLETE outcome is not upgraded.
TLS_FULL and TLS_PREFIX are separate: complete verified records before a failure are not a validated complete stream.
All strict extractor errors remain explicit. No session selection, TLS authentication, channel completeness or Graphics-fragment checks were bypassed.
Only one selected capture has a complete validated Graphics replay. Frame counts are STARTFRAME/ENDFRAME protocol headers, not rendered pixels or client presentations.
Physical-interface capture occurs before relay loss/queue treatment. No exact capture-epoch/controller-monotonic alignment exists.
Session keys, private payloads, compressed desktop data and decoded pixels are excluded. Previous campaigns and their rows are untouched.
